title: 2120. Printing the Multiplication Table of a Number
description:

Printing the Multiplication Table of a Number
65
Problem Statement
Read an integer and print its multiplication table from 1 to 10 using a for loop.
Description
Read an integer num from input. Use a for loop with a counter running from 1 to 10. On each iteration, print num, the counter, and their product in the format "num x counter = product".
Input Description
A single integer num.
Output Description
Print 10 lines showing num multiplied by each value from 1 to 10.
Sample Input
5
Sample Output
5 x 1 = 5
5 x 2 = 10
5 x 3 = 15
5 x 4 = 20
5 x 5 = 25
5 x 6 = 30
5 x 7 = 35
5 x 8 = 40
5 x 9 = 45
5 x 10 = 50
